summary: The submission consists of two PDF documents. The first file provides an inventory and initial scan of relevant literature, listing titles, authors, keywords, and brief snippets. The second file presents a topographical mapping of knowledge domains, organizing topics into a hierarchical tree covering steel manufacturing, energy-aware processes, optimization methods, AI techniques, and Industry 5.0 concepts. While these two tasks are addressed, the remaining assignment components (Synthesis & Divergence, Integrative Synthesis, Final Report) are absent.
issues: Excessive whitespace and fragmented formatting in extracted text
